title: T.140 baseline presentation semantics
scope: Presentation-level UTF-8 text and basic control behavior only. This suite does not define RTP packetization, redundancy, reordering, SIP negotiation, WebRTC transport, grapheme-cluster editing, or full T.140 conformance.

basis: T.140 code elements are transmitted using UTF-8 transformation
BEL U+0007 alerts the user during an active session
BS U+0008 erases the last entered character
LINE SEPARATOR U+2028 is the preferred new-line control
CR U+000D followed by LF U+000A is supported but not preferred
REPLACEMENT CHARACTER U+FFFD marks missing text
T140blocks carry UTF-8-coded T.140 elements without extra T.140 framing
RTP packetization, loss recovery, redundancy, and reordering are transport concerns outside this presentation suite

vectors.description: Basic IRV characters are presented unchanged.
A Latin-1 supplement character is preserved through UTF-8 encoding.
BS removes the immediately preceding entered character from the presentation model.
U+2028 advances presentation to the next line.
CR followed by LF is accepted as a supported non-preferred request for a new line.
BEL records an alert without inserting a visible text character.
U+FFFD is preserved as the explicit marker for missing T.140 data.

deferred: optional SGR and other presentation controls
